Subject: Follow-up: demo + next steps (cost & latency)

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and appreciate the demo walkthrough. I promised to follow up with a concise summary and a few qualification questions so we can size a realistic pricing scenario for you. TL;DR below, then details.

TL;DR
- Key asks from you: expected monthly token volumes (prompt + generation), target latency SLO (p95), and target budget range ($/month) or target $/1M tokens.
- I'll attach two scenarios (shared sheet): low-latency (Dedicated + streaming) vs cost-optimized (Hosted + batching).

Questions to confirm:
1) Expected monthly token volume: you mentioned ~200M to 1B tokens depending on rollout — can you confirm target for Q2 and Q3? Please give a best estimate for both prompt and generated tokens if possible.
2) Latency SLO: are you aiming for 200ms p95, 500ms p95, or is 1s acceptable for some flows?
3) Budget range: do you have a target $/1M tokens or a monthly budget band we should fit into for the MVP?
4) Workload mix: what percentage is real-time chat vs batch/async batch (report generation)?

Next steps: once you confirm the above, I'll send a short pricing matrix with three scenarios (Streaming/Dedicated, Streaming/Hosted, Batch/Hosted) and rough unit economics (estimated $/1M tokens after batching and cache assumptions).

Attachment: FintechAI_MAPlan_v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft)

Best,

From: Samir Rao <samir@fintechai.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + next steps (cost & latency)

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below:

1) Volumes: Pilot (Q2) we expect ~250M tokens/month (mostly prompts ~80M, generation ~170M). Production (Q3) could ramp to ~900M tokens/month.
2) Latency SLO: For our customer-facing chat, we want p95 <= 300ms. For background batch tasks (document summarization), 1–2s is fine.
3) Budget: For MVP we have a target of $6k–$12k / month to start; we also think in unit terms — ideally <$300 / 1M tokens effective cost after optimizations, but flexibility if latency requires higher tier.
4) Workload mix: ~65% real-time chat, 35% batch/async.

Also, we use a lot of short prompts with medium-length generations (~150 tokens) — hope that helps. Happy to schedule a quick call with your SE to validate assumptions.

Samir
Director of Product, FintechAI
samir@fintechai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo + next steps (cost & latency)

Samir — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Attached is a short pricing scenarios sheet (Redwood_pricing_scenarios.xlsx) — summary below. I kept it tight and focused on the numbers you gave (250M pilot, 900M prod; 300ms p95 target for chat).

Summary (estimates, after typical batching + cache assumptions):
- Scenario A — Low-latency, Dedicated (Streaming + reserved capacity):
  - Target: p95 ~200–300ms for chat
  - Effective unit economics: ~$420 / 1M tokens (includes reserved capacity, streaming overhead, lower batching)
  - Recommended when SLOs are strict and user-facing latency == business metric
  - Notes: Good for high-traffic productions; requires commit (monthly) — can do 3/6/12mo terms.

- Scenario B — Hybrid Hosted (Streaming for chat + Batch for heavy reports):
  - Target: p95 ~300–500ms for chat (streaming), batch tasks 1–2s
  - Effective unit economics: ~$260–$320 / 1M tokens (depends on burst patterns and cache hit rate)
  - Notes: Lower ops commitment, supports mixed workloads well.

- Scenario C — Cost-optimized Hosted (Aggressive batching + quantization):
  - Target: p95 ~500ms–1s (tradeoff for cost)
  - Effective unit economics: ~$160–$220 / 1M tokens
  - Notes: Good for non-interactive flows or where latency is less critical.

Concrete numbers for your volumes (rounded):
- Pilot (250M tokens):
  - A: ~$105k / month
  - B: ~$65k / month
  - C: ~$40k / month
- Prod (900M tokens):
  - A: ~$378k / month
  - B: ~$270k / month
  - C: ~$198k / month

I realize those absolute totals are above your stated $6k–$12k MVP band — to hit that range we'd need much lower token volumes or work with a phased plan (e.g., routing only high-value queries to low-latency tier and batching the rest). Two practical levers:
- Prefix caching & response caching for repeated prompts (can reduce billable tokens significantly for some flows).
- Hybrid routing: streaming dedicated for top X% of traffic; hosted batch for the rest.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick call with Rishi (SE) to validate token estimates and possible caching strategies — can do 30m tomorrow.
2) Identify the top 10 chat flows we can prioritize for dedicated streaming (to bound cost)
3) Helpful for us: a sample token histogram (if you can share) and any 95th percentile latency targets per route.

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_scenarios.xlsx

If you're open to it, I can also sketch a target $/1M plan where we show a hybrid split to land near your $6k–$12k MVP target. That would assume a small dedicated pool for top 15% of traffic and hosted/batched handling for the rest.

Best,
Marissa

Folks — forwarding the thread below. Key asks from FintechAI: 250M pilot / 900M prod; p95 300ms for chat; target MVP budget $6k–$12k (they know it's tight).

Recommendation: propose a hybrid plan to fit their budget with clear tradeoffs:
- Small dedicated streaming pool sized for top 15% of traffic (keeps chat p95 ~250–300ms)
- Hosted + aggressive batching and caching for the remaining 85% (bring effective $/1M down)
- Offer a 3-month reserved pilot at reduced committed rate and a 30-day measurement period to tune batching/cache.

Rishi — can you review the attached pricing sheet and add SE notes about batching latency knobs, expected batching efficiency for 150-token responses, and feasibility of prefix caching given their typical prompts?
Vivek — any guidance on promotional/pricing levers we can use to get them into the pilot without compromising margins?

I'll propose times for a joint call with Samir + Priya once Rishi confirms the technical assumptions.

Thanks,
Marissa
